settings.repere: Paragraphe · Loss of firmness, wrinkles, thin crepey
settings.text: Loss of firmness, wrinkles, thin crepey skin, jowls, turkey neck, and sagging... if it sounds incredible that all of these aging concerns are associated with just one protein, believe me, it is!

settings.repere: Paragraphe · But it's not surprising when you remembe
settings.text: But it's not surprising when you remember what's happening in most women's skin... We've been aging faster than ever before. Every day we're exposed to UV rays, pollution, stress, and skincare products that actually accelerate aging rather than prevent it.

settings.repere: Paragraphe · Not to mention our modern lifestyle that
settings.text: Not to mention our modern lifestyle that increases Progerin, the "bad"production dramatically, letting it build up in our skin cells and causing us to age before our time.

settings.text: When your skin has high levels of Progerin, these factors create havoc on our appearance, making us look years or even decades older than we should.

settings.text: When they studied how women age, they discovered Progerin increases by 3% every year. By the time a woman reaches 40, her levels become so high it begins to show dramatically in her appearance.

settings.repere: Paragraphe · The Advances in Dermatology Study in 201
settings.text: The Advances in Dermatology Study in 2012 showed something even more alarming: exposure to UVA rays from the sun significantly increases the amount of Progerin in our skin. Which is why excessive tanning prematurely ages us.

settings.repere: Paragraphe · And modern life makes this even worse. W
settings.text: And modern life makes this even worse. We're exposed to more environmental toxins, stress, and artificial ingredients than ever before -- all of which can accelerate Progerin production.

settings.repere: Paragraphe · The "anti-aging" industry knows this is
settings.text: The "anti-aging" industry knows this is happening. But instead of addressing the root cause, they keep selling temporary fixes that just mask the problem.

settings.text: Even worse, many expensive creams and treatments contain ingredients that can actually increase Progerin levels - making your skin age faster while promising to make you look younger!

settings.text: That's why I refused to recommend any traditional anti-aging products to my patients.
